text: I’ve started a small, reversible experiment to break my reading ruts using library apps like Libby. Instead of committing to a long series, I borrow one random title from a genre I usually ignore. If the book doesn't grab me within the first twenty pages, I hit return and move on. It is a low-stakes way to discover new interests without the financial cost or the mental clutter of an unfinished book sitting on my nightstand. It turns browsing into an adventure rather than a chore.
